title: Complete React.js Learning Roadmap - Coding Game Dataset
description: Syntax-to-output puzzle dataset covering the full React.js roadmap (JavaScript fundamentals through advanced React patterns), formatted like the Python dataset. Each item has a topic name, a syntax snippet, and its expected output. Blanks in the 'puzzle' field always use a number of underscores equal to the exact length of the blanked-out keyword/token (e.g. 'print' -> 5 underscores in Python; here 'console.log' -> 11 underscores), so longer JS/React keywords get proportionally longer blanks.
